June 27, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
M Holdings Securities Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 21.75% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. M Holdings Securities Inc sold 14,126 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 50,814 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.53 million, down from 64,940 at the end of the previous reported quarter. M Holdings Securities Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $906.50B market cap company. The stock increased 1.24% or $2.26 during the last trading session, reaching $184.43. About 21.72 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
